description: This file defines a web server component for the Focalboard project, including server setup, route registration, and TLS support.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Represents an HTTP server with routing, TLS support, and logging capabilities.

methods.name: NewServer
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Server instance with configuration parameters.

methods.name: Router
methods.description: Returns the router associated with the server.

methods.name: AddRoutes
methods.description: Registers a service's routes with the server's router.

methods.name: registerRoutes
methods.description: Sets up static file serving and index page route.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the server, with TLS if configured, and listens for incoming connections.
